reason: Prickle-free means no prickles.
Rank-smelling means foul-smelling, which is foetid.
Satin-like means a soft silky sheen. Glistening means sparkling or shining, so the soft-sheen meaning is lost.
Scoop-shaped is a synonym for spoon-shaped.
Semi-translucent means only partly translucent. The degree is lost.
Slanting means oblique.
Stomateless means no stomata.
Strong-scented means increased odour.
Tortuose means twisted and winding, which is close to sinuous.
Spinules are small spines, so without spinules means not spiny.
Without stomata means stomata are absent.
Basally joined is basally connate. The basal position is lost, but the meaning is otherwise connate.
Close-set means placed close together, which is approximate.
Dark cherry red is a dark red.
Equal-length means the lengths are equal.
Equally wide means equal widths when two parts are compared, or the same width throughout. It does not mean parallel-sided.
Flesh-coloured means pale pinkish.
Lateral veins are secondary leaf veins only on leaves. Bracts, petals and other parts have lateral veins that are not PO secondary leaf veins.
Laxly spaced means distant.
Lighter coloured is a comparison of colour. It does not mean discolorous, which is two surfaces of different colour. Reject it.
Marked with leaf scars means leaf scars are present.
Nearly free means not quite free. The partial union is lost.
Not deflexed (not bent downward) does not mean not reflexed (not bent backward). The two terms are different.
Pedatifid means pedately cleft, which is close to pedate.
Spoon-like means spoon-shaped.
Stellately arranged describes an arrangement of parts radiating like a star. It is not the shape of a single part.
Stocky means short and sturdy, which is close to robust.
Water-repellent means hydrophobic.
Water-shedding often describes a shape, such as a drip tip, that sheds water. It is not necessarily a hydrophobic surface.
With domatia means domatia are present.
Without clearly defined stereids means they are indistinct. It does not mean they are absent.
Bunch-forming means tufted, which is caespitose.
Inarticulate means not jointed.
Narrowly foliose means narrowly leaf-like. The narrowness is lost.
Non-stoloniferous means no stolons.
Powdered means covered in powder, which is close to mealy.
Refuse is an ordinary English word (waste), so the rule is unsafe. Any retuse reading would be a guess at a typo.
PO lists utricle as a synonym of this class. Botanically a utricle is indehiscent, but it is close enough.
Degraded can mean decayed or worn. It does not mean vestigial, which is a reduced organ.
Densely placed means crowded.
Narrowly cylindric is cylindrical in shape.
Broader above the middle is the definition of obovate.
Naviculiform means boat-shaped, which is scaphoid.
PO lists siliqua as a synonym of silique.
Slightly widened loses the small degree. It is also only increased relative to something else.
Unawned means no awns.
Untoothed means not toothed.
Alternately long and short means unequal.
Gynandrous means stamens joined with the pistil, as in orchids. Androgynous means male and female flowers together. The two are different.
Late-dehiscent means opening late. The timing is lost, and a plain dehiscent value would be wrong for it.
